mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aftersale (order_id, order_no, user_id, shop_id, type, reason, refund_amount, images, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{shopId}, #{type}, #{reason}, #{refundAmount}, #{images}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM aftersale WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aftersale WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status IN (0, 1)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aftersale WHERE shop_id = #{shopId}
AND status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aftersale WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND status = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE aftersale SET status = #{status}, reply = #{reply}, handle_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_id = #{shopId} AND status = 0
